text:
maria (prod): starting a short working group to finalize enterprise compliance launch gates for audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 evidence bundles, and retention. target: pilot-ready for Dedicated in ~8-12w.
kevin (eng): ok. can we scope priorities around customer blockers? dedicated/private asks seem most urgent.
ashley (security): agree — top security blockers: tenant-scoped immutable audit stream, BYOK onboarding + rotation constraints, legal-hold/retention overrides.
samir (ops): ops needs: reproducible runbooks for evidence exports, incident retrieval SLA, and archive cost model before we commit to SLAs.
maria (prod): propose milestones: M1 = tenant append-only audit + retention tiers; M2 = BYOK onboarding API + preflight; M3 = evidence export + legal-hold controls; M4 = SOC2/ISO evidence packaging automation. thoughts?
kevin (eng): pragmatic approach — M1 can be append-only objects with daily signed manifests (cheap) and later we can add stronger attestation (merkle/attestation) for customers that require it.
ashley (security): call that "tamper-evidence v1 = signed manifests; v2 = merkle/remote attestation" in acceptance criteria. BYOK must enforce key policies: no plaintext key storage, no cross-tenant decryption by Redwood.
maria (prod): draft acceptance criteria (high level):
- M1: per-tenant append-only audit stream; retention tiers configurable (30d/1y/7y); daily signed manifests for snapshots.
- M2: BYOK onboarding API with escrow toggle; rotation handshake documented; no plaintext customer keys retained by Redwood.
- M3: evidence export CLI/API (zip + checksum + metadata); legal-hold toggle to prevent GC and notify ops.
- M4: SOC2/ISO bundle builder: one-click export for last 12 months with searchable metadata.
kevin (eng): question: retention granularity — per-tenant vs per-route (inference logs vs admin events). per-route adds index complexity; perhaps start per-tenant and offer export filters.
samir (ops): prefer per-tenant tiers to avoid index explosion. ops can keep a cold archive for long-tail retention if customers request.
ashley (security): some customers will demand 7+ years for admin events. we should allow pinning events to long-term retention via legal-hold or explicit promotion. record in runbook.
dara (legal): exports must include chain-of-custody metadata: requestor identity, request auth, checksum, export TTL, and an attestation string for contracts. we should prepare sample clause.
maria (prod): noted. we'll draft contract language for tamper-evidence and BYOK responsibilities.
kevin (eng): BYOK implementation options: (A) delegated KMS calls to customer KMS (no keys stored), (B) customer root envelope encrypted with our HSM support. (A) is simpler operationally but requires network access to customer KMS. (B) helps offline escrow scenarios.
ashley (security): prefer supporting both modes: default (A) for self-serve, (B) as an enterprise/regulatory option. ensure minimum required policies for keys in both cases.
maria (prod): agreed. product will document supported modes and a KMS capabilities checklist for sales/solutions.
samir (ops): onboarding automation: require a preflight that validates KMS reachability, policy checks (encrypt/decrypt as needed), and a test decrypt. surface results in console.
kevin (eng): will stub kms-preflight API now. sample response: {"status":"ok","kms_reachable":true,"policy_ok":true}. deploy-bot: kms-preflight deployed to staging (build 2026.03.22).
ashley (security): acceptance test matrix for pilots: preflight pass, signed manifest verification, export round-trip (export -> import), legal-hold exercise. all green => Dedicated onboarding eligible.
maria (prod): gating ownership proposal: Product approves PRD/acceptance criteria, Security validates controls, Ops validates runbooks/costs, Legal approves contract clauses. fail any => Beta-only.
dara (legal): add data residency declarations to contract attachments per customer region.
kevin (eng): timeline rough: M1 signed manifests + retention toggles ~6w with focused sprints; BYOK (A) pilot 8-10w in parallel; evidence export/legal-hold another 4w. pilot-ready overall ~3 months.
maria (prod): prioritization recommendation: 1) M1 (high blocker), 2) BYOK pilot (sales-driven), 3) evidence export + legal-hold, 4) SOC2 bundle automation. OK?
samir (ops): yes. ops to join early on M1 architecture to design archive lifecycle and billing tags.
ashley (security): BYOK must include preflight + monitoring before onboarding paying customers. put that dependency explicit.
maria (prod): action items:
- kevin: PRD for M1 w/ signed-manifest spec + retention API (due Tue).
- ashley: security acceptance matrix + key policy templates (due Wed).
- samir: ops runbook skeleton + archive cost model (due Wed).
- dara: draft contract clause incl tamper-evidence & BYOK responsibilities (due Fri).
- maria: schedule WG checkpoint next Thu 11am PT.
kevin (eng): dropping stub PR in GH and will ping eng-runtime.
dara (legal): note: some customers will want escrow access; prepare an "escrow appendix" template.
maria (prod): will include escrow option in PRD.
ashley (security): telemetry ask: alert on anomalous export rates (possible exfil). ops to include in runbook and hook to SIEM.
samir (ops): will add export anomaly detection and integrate with existing incident playbooks.
maria (prod): quick emoji-check to proceed?
kevin (eng): :thumbsup:
ashley (security): :thumbsup:
dara (legal): :thumbsup:
samir (ops): :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: staging rollout for kms-preflight at 6123456810 succeeded.
